title: Jaime's blue ball of energy during meditation

tellings.quote: this big uh blue ball I guess this like ball of energy, as he describes it, appeared.

plain: An unnamed researcher, on a Jesse Michels episode about a scientist said to have contacted an alien council, tells of a man named Jaime in the 1970s at the lab of a researcher named Puharich. According to the account passed on from Puharich's assistant, while Jaime was meditating a big blue ball, described as a ball of energy, appeared. It is told as a sign of contact with something beyond the ordinary.
